source: Live supplied FAC 1.1.5; point nucleus, infinite mass, Breit/SE/VP off
script:
SetAtom('Ne',10,-1,0)
SetBreit(0)
SetSE(0)
SetVP(0)
SetMS(0,0)
SetRadialGrid(2000,-1,-1,-1)
SetTransitionCut(0)
Config('g','1s1')
Config('p','2p1')
Config('d','3d1')
OptimizeRadial(['g'])
Structure('levels.b',['g','p','d'])
MemENTable('levels.b')
PrintTable('levels.b','levels.txt',1)
SetTransitionOptions(2,1)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['p'],-1)
TransitionTable('lines.b',['g'],['d'],-2)
PrintTable('lines.b','lines.txt',1)
columns: upper, twice J upper, lower, twice J lower, eV, gf, A per s, reduced multipole amplitude
